decks.name: moscone-south
decks.why: Moscone Center South's roof deck (Yerba Buena Gardens: the children's garden, the carousel, the ice rink and bowling centre, the Children's Creativity Museum), 4th, Howard, 3rd and Folsom Streets: the DEM's ground stands 5-9 m over the streets on its walls

meta.definition: Per deck, cells [i, j, old, new] of public/data/sf/sf-elevation.bin.gz (i east, j south; heights NAVD88 centimetres on the surveyed plan): the cells within one 8 m cell of the deck (the 2 m points of the USGS 1 m DEM 1.5 m or more over the street grade, connected to the deck's seed; the street grade the inverse-distance mean of the DEM along the carriageways at grade within 150 m), each given the harmonic fill (the mean of its four neighbours) of the cells round them. A reader refuses the table if the grid's version, frame or any cell's old height differs.

sources.dem: USGS 3D Elevation Program 1 m DEM (public domain), the six tiles of external/dem/1m/PROVENANCE.json
